reviews.x: Purchased these on a whim, after seeing any reviews online for self tanner. Was skeptical at first but easily fell in love with these!!! After showering and exfoliating well in the shower I just mixed about 8 drops per limb with my lotion I would typically put on after showering and BOOM! Ready to go! Didn’t rub off on my clothing and left a nice glowing tan to my skin. Did take about 12 hours to fully develop but loving the nice tan color it gave me!!

It does not make me look orange or fake. It also doesn't fade in a wierd way either. It looks so natural.  I definitely will be re ordering this product.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the tan as natural-looking and not orange.
Users find the drops easy to use by mixing them into moisturizer.
Many reviewers appreciate being able to customize the tan intensity by adjusting the number of drops.
Several reviewers note little to no scent.
Some reviewers mention streaks or needing trial and error with mixing and drop amounts.

qa.q: How do I mix these drops with my moisturizer?
qa.answer: Add a few drops to your moisturizer and mix them in very well before applying; start with just a few drops if you're fair-skinned [2][3]. The number of drops varies by desired tan and skin tone, ranging from half a drop to a full dropper [5][6].

claims.text: Add a drop or two to your moisturizer and mix the drops in very well before applying [2][3].
Start with just a few drops if you are fair skinned [2].
The amount of drops depends on the level of tan you want, from half a drop to a full dropper [5][6].

qa.q: Will this make me look orange?
qa.answer: No, reviews say it did not turn them orange, including pale users [1][4][5]. One pale reviewer noted it gave a natural, non-orangey brown tan [4].

claims.text: A very pale user said it wasn't orange at all on them [1].
A pale user said it delivers a rich brown tan, not orangey [4].
Another user reported no orange tint [5].

qa.q: How long does the tan last?
qa.answer: One reviewer says the tan lasts 2-3 days when patting the face dry after showers [1], while another describes using it once a week [6].

claims.text: The tan lasts 2-3 days for one reviewer if you pat your face dry after showers instead of rubbing.
Another reviewer adds three drops to body lotion once a week.

qa.q: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Does it have a strong smell?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it has no scent or very little odor [2][3][5], while others report a yogurt-like smell [1] or a distinct "self tanner" smell [6].

claims.text: Some reviewers report no scent or very little odor.
Other reviewers report a yogurt-like smell or a distinct self tanner smell.
